name.description: Name of the video (default: the file name).

url.description: Web: the page to start on.

app.description: Desktop: the application to film, as the OS names it. With "screen": true, the app brought to the front first (optional).

screen.description: Desktop: film the whole main screen instead of one app's window, to show several apps or the menu bar. Everything on screen is filmed (notifications, other windows, the menu bar icons): close or hide what should not be seen.

hideOthers.description: Desktop, macOS, with "screen": true: hide the other apps before filming (Hide Others, ⌥⌘H, in `app`). Default false.

viewport.description: Web: browser size in CSS pixels (default: the video's shape with a longer side of 1440, such as 1440x810 for 16:9, so the page fills the frame when padding is 0).

scale.description: Web: device pixel ratio of the capture (default 2, Retina).

storageState.description: Path to a session saved by `screenplay login`.

background.description: A preset (aurora, sky, dusk, ember, graphite, lagoon, lilac, peach, linen; default aurora), a color like #0f172a, an image path (relative to the file that sets it), or a gradient { "gradient": ["#0ea5e9", "#6366f1"], "angle": 135 }.

gradient.description: 2 to 4 hex colors, from the start of the gradient to its end.

angle.description: Direction in degrees, as in CSS: 90 goes left to right, 180 top to bottom (default 135).

padding.description: Space around the recording, in output pixels (default 72).

shadow.description: Drop shadow under the recording (default true).

cursor.description: Cursor drawn in the video (default macos).

maxZoom.description: Highest automatic zoom (default 1.9). Automatic zooms also stop where the capture runs out of pixels, so a small app window that already fills the video is not zoomed; a number in a step's `zoom` still forces it.

autoZoom.description: Zoom automatically on clicks and typing (default true).

captions.description: Show the `say` text as captions (default true).

accent.description: Accent color for clicks, callouts and highlights (default #3b82f6).

frame.description: Draw a minimal browser window bar above web recordings (default none).

cards.description: Show the title and end cards (default false: `title` and `end` steps are left out of the video). Turn on when the person wants an intro and an outro.

enabled.description: Speak each step's `say` text (default false). Needs CARTESIA_API_KEY or ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, unless every spoken step has its own `audio` file.

provider.description: Who speaks (default: Cartesia when CARTESIA_API_KEY is set, else ElevenLabs when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is).

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, fr, de (default en).

id.description: The provider's voice id (default: a narration voice).

model.description: The provider's model (default sonic-3.6 for Cartesia, eleven_multilingual_v2 for ElevenLabs).

path.description: Where to write the MP4 (default: next to the scenario, same name).

goto.description: URL or path to open (relative to the scenario url).

say.description: Narration for this step: shown as a caption, and spoken when voice is enabled. The step lasts at least as long as the sentence.

zoom.description: false: keep the camera wide for this step. A number: force this zoom level (1 = no zoom).

audio.description: An audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A…) with this step's narration, relative to the scenario: used instead of generating `say`, with no voice key. The step lasts at least as long as the file.

hold.description: Extra seconds to stay on the result of this step before the next one.

app.description: Desktop: the app this step acts in (default: the scenario's app, or the last one opened). Another app than the scenario's needs "screen": true; there it also becomes the app the next steps act in.

surface.description: Desktop: where to look for the element: window (default, the app's front window), menubar (the app's menus in the menu bar), menu (an open menu), sheet, popover or alert.

open.description: Desktop, with "screen": true: launch this app or bring it to the front. The next steps act in it.
